APPROVE
The extraction keeps the same logic and evaluation order (the inverted `reported.Add` check and the moved `Under`/`IsTestInput` helpers are equivalent), and leaves `ChangeFilters` well under 15, though I couldn't find the source on this machine to confirm that `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation` and `JsInventory.Inventory` are the right type names and that the new `Under` doesn't clash with an existing member of the partial class.
